title: Replicate handling
prompt: Assess agreement between the four endpoint samples (treat_rep1, treat_rep2, ctrl_rep1, ctrl_rep2) and decide which to keep for the treatment-vs-control comparison. Report the samples to keep and the samples to exclude.
grader_plain: Both sets must match exactly: keep treat_rep1, ctrl_rep1, ctrl_rep2; exclude treat_rep2.
context: You are analyzing a pooled CRISPR knockout screen. The workspace contains raw sgRNA read counts (counts.tsv), a sample sheet, gene sets and a short design document (design.md). Read design.md first.
